name: CyberSecEval
intro: CyberSecEval 3 是 Meta 的网络安全风险与能力评测套件，围绕第三方风险以及应用开发者与终端用户风险构建八类评测，并比较护栏启用前后的表现。
build_method: 风险分类, 模拟实验, 人类研究, 可执行任务
metric: 成功率, 攻击增益, 不安全输出率, 恶意请求遵从率
task_type: 网络安全评测, 安全测试
eval_feature: 八类风险, 第三方与应用风险, 护栏前后对照, 人工与自动化评判
build_method_en: Risk Taxonomy, Simulations, Human Study, Executable Tasks
eval_feature_en: Eight Risks, Third-party and Application Risk, Before/After Guardrails, Human and Automated Review
intro_en: CyberSecEval 3 is Meta's cybersecurity risk and capability suite covering eight evaluations across third-party risk and risk to application developers and end users, with mitigation-aware comparisons.
metric_en: Success Rate, Attack Uplift, Insecure Output Rate, Malicious-request Compliance Rate
drawio_review_note: Aligned with arXiv:2408.01605 (CyberSecEval 3), especially Figure 1 and Sections 3-5. The generic catalog item is explicitly anchored to version 3 because it is the paper-backed suite with a complete eight-risk methodology and official PurpleLlama implementation. The diagram separates four third-party risks from four application/end-user risks, preserves their distinct human, simulated, executable, and prompt-corpus protocols, and shows the paper's before/after mitigation comparisons using PromptGuard, CodeShield, and Llama Guard 3.
